report:
Reviewed the complete owned_products claim and both associated tests, including TODO metadata. Baseline: independently compared historical implementation_sources and test_sources against current files by joining the stored lines; sig.rs, finalize.rs, and semantic_spec.rs all match exactly. The supplied prior report gives genuine claim-specific rationale; I reassessed its limitations rather than treating its approval as proof.

Fresh source evidence: the ordinary sig.rs association implements Check::new with a separately created target_stash while source_stash is borrowed; finish moves the target into Stashed::new. Additional captured finalize.rs lines 1–190 show body finalization also starts a new target stash, copies root/types into that target, and returns Stashed::new(target, body). The ordinary annotated body_finalization_resolves_types_into_a_fresh_stash test visibly asserts that the original inference type remains InferVar(0), while the returned body's tuple retains one element resolved to i32. These assertions meaningfully demonstrate source preservation and independent completed body data for that example. They do not establish all signature/body shapes or prove absence of every source/CST pointer.

All claim aspects are accounted for: fresh owned signature/body storage and self-contained Stashed products have the partial implementation/example evidence above; immutable CST/source-lifetime independence and complete structural isolation still require the explicitly deferred traversal matrix. Deterministic content fingerprints rather than allocation identity, and use of equal fingerprints to stop downstream recomputation/backdating, remain explicitly deferred by sage_meta::todo::checking_owned_products. Its comment specifies the prerequisites: structural traversal capable of detecting source-stash/tree-sitter pointers, equal-recomputation fingerprint comparisons, and a persistent edit test observing downstream execution. The empty TODO body is not behavioral evidence. No N/A entries exist. Accepting this existing deferral does not certify complete implementation or full coverage; no additional edits to this accounting are needed.

Execution: ran review start, captured helper ranges via review read, and independently executed the baseline comparison. No behavior tests or build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator's reported 321-test suite and build are separate execution context, not independent evidence of these deferred guarantees.
